reading.title: Neptune Sextile Pluto Under Libra's Fall
overview: The sky holds Sun at 29° Libra in fall, conjunct Venus at 2° Scorpio retrograde in detriment, while Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde maintains a tight sextile to Pluto at 3° Aquarius in fall. Moon at 16° Pisces is not void and next aspects Mercury at 21° Scorpio by trine. Mars at 14° Leo trines Saturn at 10° Aries retrograde, and Uranus at 5° Gemini retrograde trines Pluto.

Mundane tradition reads the Neptune-Pluto sextile as slow shifts in collective beliefs and power structures, with Uranus also aspecting both outer planets. Venus square Pluto and Sun square Pluto suggest intensified pressures on values and authority, while Mercury square Jupiter and square Mars point to heated rhetoric and information conflicts. Mars trine Saturn indicates attrition and blockades rather than swift gains.

The last New Moon at Libra 17° falls in house 11 for the United States and house 6 for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran, framing legislative alliances or armed forces and public health. Transits to national angles remain within 2° for several charts, though the fair tests show these configurations align with events no better than chance.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC while squaring natal Venus and sextiling natal Uranus; Mars trines the ASC and sextiles natal Saturn. These contacts coincide with reports on campaign ads and midterm budget strains, though the lore does not demonstrate predictive linkage beyond the given transits.

Neptune squares the natal Sun, Mars conjoins the ASC, and Uranus trines natal Saturn while Jupiter squares natal Venus and Pluto. The configuration sits with news of resumed trilateral Ukraine talks, consistent with the listed positions but without verified causal effect.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn, Saturn squares natal Uranus, and Neptune sextiles natal Saturn. The lunation in house 6 and Mars in house 4 align with economic briefings on the war's fifth winter, within the bounds of the computed transits.

Pluto opposes natal Moon, Uranus sextiles natal Moon, and Jupiter sextiles the ASC while squaring natal Sun; Saturn sextiles natal Mercury and opposes natal Neptune. These occur alongside parliamentary network reports, matching the exact aspects listed.

Pluto conjoins natal Moon and ASC, Neptune sextiles both ASC and Moon, and Jupiter squares the MC while Mars sextiles natal Mercury. The lunation in house 4 frames land and opposition themes, with the positions as computed.

Saturn conjoins natal Sun, Uranus squares natal Venus, and the Sun sextiles natal ASC while squaring natal Jupiter. These transits stand with the given chart data and no further interpretive addition.

reading.lore_and_intel: Neptune sextile Pluto overlaps with Black Sea election concerns and Saudi executions at z 4.8 and 4.2; Venus square Pluto and Uranus trine Pluto touch border water reports and Hormuz transit markets at z 4.4 and 3.4; Sun conjunction Venus and Mercury square Jupiter coincide with influencer cases and antisemitism inquiries at z 8.4 and 6.8. Mars trine Saturn and Mercury square Mars meet PLA sortie counts and Sudan drone assessments at z 4.2 and 3.5. The lore does not extend to charts or dates absent from the computed positions, and several listed intel items show no direct aspect overlap.

reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflictions, full moons, and eclipses perform no better than chance in forecasting air-raid alarms, rocket alerts, personnel losses, or magnitude 6+ earthquakes, with differences of -5% to +35% and corrected p-values of 1.00. Mars retrograde and new or full moons likewise yield results indistinguishable from random expectation. The fair tests therefore supply no evidence that these astrological factors predict the events in question.
